description_zh: 调用该接口更新声码排程
name: UpdateSoundCodeSchedule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The schedule name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 排程名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The schedule description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 排程描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The schedule status. Valid values:

WORKING: Enabled.

STOP: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
排程状态。

WORKING：启用。

STOP：停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The daily start time of the schedule. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59
parameters.help_zh: 排程每日开始工作时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The daily end time of the schedule. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 排程每日结束工作时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59，不能早于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start date of the schedule. The value is in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 排程开始工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the schedule. The value is in the yyyy-MM-dd format and cannot be earlier than StartDate
parameters.help_zh: 排程结束工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd，不得早于StartDate
parameters.name: end_date

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
